Subject: MAP draft + next steps: vendor onboarding/procurement

Thanks again for the call earlier, Samantha — really appreciate the clarity on timelines. As discussed, I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-Acme-Analytics-v1.xlsx) that pulls the vendor onboarding/procurement milestone into the overall plan. Key items under that milestone: Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor registration form, W-9, banking details for ACH, and procurement sign-off.

Quick recap and asks: 
- Target close date: 2026-02-12 (per our win window) — can your side confirm this is still realistic?
- Dependencies: your procurement team completing the Ariba/Coupa vendor registration, and finance provisioning the W-9 + bank info.
- Responsibilities: Redwood to provide vendor contact info, Redwood legal to fill any required vendor questionnaire; Acme procurement to create the vendor record in Ariba/Coupa and confirm vendor ID.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the preferred procurement system (Ariba vs Coupa) and procurement contact — I can loop them into the MAP.
2) If you can send the vendor form + W-9, I'll confirm our legal/finance responses in 48 hours.
3) We'll keep the 2026-02-12 target but will add a short contingency for procurement lead time.

Attachments: MAP-Acme-Analytics-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks Marissa — the MAP looks good and aligns to our internal expectations. A few quick answers: 

- Procurement system: we use Coupa for third-party vendors.
- Procurement contact: looping in procurement@acme-analytics.com (cc’d). Please work with them on the vendor setup; they will create the vendor record and send back the Coupa vendor ID.
- Attachments we'll send: our standard vendor registration form + W-9. Finance prefers ACH for payments and will need banking details + company tax id.

One ask from our side: does Redwood have a vendor questionnaire/SSPL or any standard security attestation we need to attach to the vendor file? If so, please share.

Target close: Feb 12 still looks possible if procurement moves within the next 2 weeks.

Hi all — attaching completed vendor registration + W-9 from Acme (Acme_Vendor_Form_Completed.pdf, Acme_W9.pdf). We created the Coupa vendor shell and will send the vendor ID after you confirm the company tax id and bank instructions.

Coupa vendor fields we used: company_name, tax_id (EIN), remit_address, invoice_email, contact_name, contact_email, bank_name, account_last4, payment_terms. Please confirm which of these you'll populate; if you prefer to submit via our secure portal, we'll send a one-time secure upload link.

If you can confirm bank details via secure upload or DocuSign by EOD Friday (2026-01-16), we'll aim to push the vendor to active status the week of 2026-01-19, which keeps your Feb 12 MAP line feasible.

Attachments: Acme_Vendor_Form_Completed.pdf, Acme_W9.pdf
